{{Icon|Weaken icon|text=false|nolink=true}} [[Weakness]], formerly known as '''Weaken''', is a type of debuff inflicted to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When enemies are inflicted with '''Weakness''', they temporarily deal reduced damage for a set duration. The number represents the degree of reduction.

Multiple sources of '''Weakness''' stack <u>multiplicatively</u> to form the '''Weakness Multiplier''' for that damage instance. The resulting Weakness Multiplier then stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
